$description: OPAX design tokens: one source for the web (portal/public CSS variables) and the app (mobile/src/design, React Native). PROPOSAL from design review pass 1 (docs/design/DESIGN-REVIEW-2026-10.md). Nothing reads this file yet. Pass 2 adds the generator that writes portal/public/tokens.css and mobile/src/design/tokens.generated.ts from it. Values are CSS px on the web and points on iOS / dp on Android: one CSS pixel is one point. A `platform` block overrides a value for one platform; `sizeClass` overrides it at iPad regular width or a web viewport of 701px and over.

opax.rules: Screens use role names, never hex values.
One accent per view. The accent belongs to the screen's subject, not to each section.
Party colour is a dot beside a readable party name, never colour alone, never a chart series.
inkFaint is for paper and raised surfaces only; use inkSoft on sunken surfaces and washes.
bronze (#A0761B) is never text. Text that touches the record uses bronzeInk.

sunken.$description: Subdued surface, pressed rows, empty portrait circle, skeleton bars.

inkSoft.$description: Secondary text, metadata, fine print. 6.5:1 on paper, 6.0:1 on sunken.

inkFaint.$description: Tertiary text on paper and raised only (4.56 / 4.80:1). Fails on sunken and on washes.

navy.$description: Structure and the one primary action per view.

navyWash.$description: Secondary button fill; people accent wash.

bronze.$description: Rules, chart marks and the masthead rule. Never text (3.9:1).

bronzeInk.$description: Record links, tags, focus ring on paper. 5.6:1.

bronzeWash.$description: Tag fill, search highlight. Web keeps rgba(160,118,27,0.16), which flattens to this over paper.

bronzeRule.$description: Link underline on the web. App: none (links are rows).

bronzeBright.$description: Bronze legible on navy: the mark, focus ring on navy.

divider.$description: Top rule of a section. Decorative (1.97:1).

dividerSubtle.$description: Between rows, under subheadings, card outlines. Decorative (1.30:1). Replaces the web --line and app `line` names.

control.$description: Field and segmented-control boundaries only (3.33:1). Never a content divider. Replaces --line-strong / lineStrong.

dangerPressed.$description: Pressed destructive button (the End call button). New role: replaces the raw hex in talk/CallControls.tsx.

accent.$description: Category accents. `ink` is text-safe (AA) on paper, raised, sunken and its own wash; ink and inkSoft are AA on every wash. Use only for: the 2pt section mark, the display figure of a block, an icon tile, a Today tile. Never for links, rules, chip fills or body text.

people.$description: People and places share this pair; the app's separate `places` key is removed.

status.$description: Status labels (bill stage, division outcome, vote side). Always a word; the tone only reinforces it.

done.$description: Passed, agreed to, became law, voted for.

party.$description: Dot colour (10pt dot, always beside the party name) and a 12% wash for a party's own page header only. The money-map exporter (scripts/export_money_graph.py, export_state_money.py) moves to these values in pass 2; it currently draws Labor #D93025, Nationals #1B5E20, Greens #3C9A46, One Nation #E8710A.

mark.$description: The subject series: bars, lines, the one highlighted value.

contrast.$description: The second series where a chart compares two (noes against ayes).

industry.$description: Categorical palette for the money map's 16 industry clusters, today copied in graph/palette.ts, app.js DONOR_GROUP_COLOURS, ledger.js, home.html and mobile features/money/ported/palette.ts. Values move here unchanged in pass 2; each hue keeps its darkened ink for labels.

colorHighContrast.$description: Increase Contrast (iOS) and prefers-contrast: more (web, new in pass 2). Each text role steps one stronger; subtle dividers take the default divider colour; accent inks and bronzeInk step to 7:1 on their wash and every surface.

serif.$description: Titles, headings, record text, display figures. Web stack: Merriweather, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif. App: static Merriweather Regular and Bold (Bold stands in for the web's 600).

sans.$description: Interface, body, metadata, labels, controls. Web stack: Public Sans, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif.

system.$description: Native chrome only: tab bar, bar buttons, menus, alerts, keyboard (SF Pro / Roboto).

type.$description: Eleven roles, six sizes (plus the page title's fluid web size and its iPad step). Sentence case everywhere: no uppercase or letter-spaced labels. App roles carry the Dynamic Type ramp they scale with, to AX5, uncapped. Numbers in figures and tables are tabular.

title.$description: The page's one title: a person's name, a bill title, a screen name. Root app screens use the native large title in this face.

display.$description: The one number a block is about ($622,102; 2,929 divisions). Serif because Public Sans tabular digits read as monospace when large. May take the view's accent ink.

subheading.$description: A row title that leads a block: a bill title in a list, a division title, a report card.

record.$description: The words of the record and long reading: speeches, report essays, In short.

strong.$description: Names in rows, values in key-value lists, inline figures (with tabular).

metadata.$description: The one meta line under a title: kind · date · place.

fine.$description: Source lines, saved-copy notices, one short caveat. Never below 13.

label.$description: Tags, status labels, party labels, field labels. Replaces kicker / tag / chip roles and the web's uppercase .kicker.

space.$description: One vertical rhythm (the app's `rhythm`, adopted by the web). Section and screen steps grow at regular width.

line.$description: A line bound to the line above: a date under a title.

tight.$description: Inside a row or group: a name to its party line.

row.$description: Either side of a row hairline (content rows). Control rows own their 44pt and sit 2pt from the hairline.

heading.$description: A section heading to its first block.

group.$description: A second list or group inside a section.

section.$description: Between sections; the rule sits at the top of each.

radius.$description: Shape tells the reader what it is: press = pill, read = sm, hold = md. Circles (portraits, dots) are 50%.

sm.$description: Things you read: tags, status labels, text fields, focus outlines, icon tiles.

md.$description: Things that hold content: cards (Today, leads, report cards), sheets, popovers, the Ask composer, the map frame, the error panel.

pill.$description: Things you press: buttons, choice chips, filter chips, the segmented track and its thumb, the machine-written label, Follow.

hairline.$description: Every rule, row line and card outline. 1px = 1pt, not the device hairline.

focus.$description: Focus ring (bronzeInk on paper, bronzeBright on navy), field error, Composer focus.

accentMark.$description: Short accent stroke over the start of a section's top rule. Only on screens whose sections differ in category (profiles, Today).

masthead.$description: The bronze rule under the web masthead and over the footer. The only 3px rule; remove the 2-3px bronze edges on cards, tiles and panels.

elevation.$description: Structure is hairlines. One shadow, for things that float over the page.

overlay.$description: Menus, popovers, the source sheet on the web, the map popup, the docked chat. App: native sheets and menus draw their own.

standard.$description: Disclosure open, chevron turn, chip select.

gentle.$description: Portrait fade-in, answer reveal, sheet content.

ambient.$description: The one ambient loop (the wombat walk, the Talk orb breath).

standard.$description: The web's house curve; the app's Animated/Reanimated default for UI.

reduced.$description: Under Reduce Motion / prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, colour changes only, loaders draw a still frame.

target.$description: Minimum hit area. Visuals may be smaller inside it.

web.$description: Web compact grows to 44 on coarse pointers.

portrait.$description: Blank sunken circle when there is no portrait; never initials.

icon.$description: Three icon sizes (the app draws 11 today). Icons scale with text to 2x.

measure.$description: Readable line length on the web; app readable column 700.

breakpoint.$description: iPad size classes and the web's two layout steps (web: 701px and 1101px min-width).

$deprecated.$description: Pass 2 removes these. Left: current name. Right: canonical replacement.

app.Tag, Figure, MoneyFigure (0 uses): remove (Tag returns as the canonical tag)
